properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for enabling MDE on Servers to get the inventory in the MDE portal.
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm the enforcement of measures that maintain an accurate inventory of all software assets and identify any that have reached end-of-life or lack vendor support. Continuously monitor for unsupported software usage and generate alerts for compliance violations.
